observations: Single car headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic film.
The headlight features a modern design with a horizontal slatted pattern.
The housing appears to be made of black plastic.
The lens surface is covered by the plastic wrap, obscuring the actual optical quality.
The item is resting on a concrete floor.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may conceal significant surface scratches or deep cracks on the lens.
risks.proof: A photo of the headlight with the plastic wrap completely removed.

risks.risk: The internal bulb and reflector assembly may be missing or broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the headlight showing the bulb and mounting hardware.
risks.if_unproven: as missing the bulb and reflector

risks.risk: The headlight may be a generic aftermarket part rather than a genuine Toyota OEM unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label or part number on the housing.

proof_requests: Photo of the headlight with the plastic wrap removed to inspect the lens.
Photo of the rear of the headlight to check the bulb and reflector.
Photo of any label or sticker on the housing showing the brand and part number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
